column3: Close to the Greek; “Cohort” is rendered “Regiment.”
NKJV adds “He will tell you what you must do,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text ends with “by the sea.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV supplies “Cornelius” as subject.
NKJV includes “bound” and “descending to him,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “being let down by four corners.”
NKJV has “four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, creeping things,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “four-footed animals and creeping things of the earth.”
NKJV has “again,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “immediately.”
NKJV includes “who had been sent to him from Cornelius,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “to the men.”
Close to the Greek; “righteous” is rendered “just.”
NKJV names “Peter,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “having risen, he went.”
NKJV has “they entered,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “he entered.”
NKJV has “I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Four days ago at this hour I was praying at the ninth hour.”
